input.objective: Deploy the NFT, vault, liquidity contract and renderer from this repository on Ethereum mainnet, in this order, with no changes to their logic: (1) InkPortraits with constructor ($owner); (2) InkVault with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, 0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d, $owner); (3) InkLiquidity with constructor (the official Uniswap v4 PoolManager on this chain, the official Uniswap v4 PositionManager on this chain, $owner, 0xbc10b3662231c830d2ee10bc6359db17bea4b3d4); (4) InkRenderer with constructor ($contract:InkPortraits, $owner). Do not deploy src/InkFeeRouter.sol: the owner deploys it separately. Run the existing Foundry tests before deploying. The treasury argument (0xbc10b3662231c830d2ee10bc6359db17bea4b3d4) only receives IMD fees and is not an owner. Owner roles and royalties must go to $owner, the address in the owner field, never to the deploying wallet or any swarm address. Do not add any other owner, admin or upgrade role. Do not deploy src/testnet.
